articles.title: The Clarity Act isn't a ticket to sanctions evasion, actually
articles.snippet: The bill, as currently drafted, has the power to stop sanctions evasion at scale, argues Ari Redbord, global head of policy at TRM Labs.

articles.title: Czech Republic tells ISPs to block Polymarket after gambling blacklisting
articles.snippet: The Czech Finance Ministry added Polymarket to its blacklist of unauthorized online gambling websites, requiring internet providers to block access within 15 days.

articles.title: UK government defers capital gains on certain crypto with ‘no gain, no loss’ approach
articles.snippet: The change in tax policy, expected to affect about 700,000 people in the UK, is tied to the disposal of crypto in lending and liquidity pools.

articles.title: Base Creator Jesse Pollak Steps Back From App Leadership After Admitting Social Bet 'Was Wrong'
articles.snippet: Pollak said he is handing the Base App back to Coinbase to focus on building Base into "the blockchain for global finance" after conceding the network's push into on-chain social missed the mark.

articles.title: Bitcoin Ticks Up to $64K Following Largest Inflation Slowdown in Six Years
articles.snippet: Consumer prices cooled more than expected in June, yet geopolitical tensions continue to cast a shadow over crypto prices
